name: Practice Pathfinder
description: Humanized Practice Mode auto-solver that feeds real clicks to your macro recorder for showcases

enabled.name: Start enabled
enabled.description: Turn the solver on as soon as you enter a level. Toggle it mid-run with <cy>F6</c>, switch Mode 1 / 2 / 3 with <cy>F7</c>. Works on any keyboard layout (Turkish too). It only plays while you are in <cg>Practice Mode</c>.

auto-checkpoints.name: Auto checkpoints
auto-checkpoints.description: Place practice checkpoints automatically after about 0.8-1.2 s of safe progress, or right after clearing a portal or orb.

max-failures.name: Failures before backtracking (Mode 1)
max-failures.description: Mode 1 only: when a checkpoint collects more deaths than this, it is deleted and the solver goes back to the previous checkpoint. Mode 2 uses 65 and Mode 3 uses 120.

reactive-assist.name: Jump assist
reactive-assist.description: In cube and robot mode, try a window-centered jump over spikes the solver can already see, so fewer deaths are needed. The search still fixes any mistakes.

block-manual-input.name: Ignore my clicks while solving
block-manual-input.description: While the solver is on, your own clicks are ignored so they don't end up in your macro.

show-hud.name: Show status label
show-hud.description: Show the small status label in the top-right corner of the level.
